notes: North is up. Names: this plate prints GARRARD ... STREET and McLEAN ... STREET (both read upward along the street), so Garrard and McLean are recorded as Street here (22-9L has them as Avenue; names.key() matches either). DALTON AVENUE, VOGT ST., CURRAN, HORNE, OEHLER, W. NINTH, EIGHTH, W. COURT (on 22-6R). The N-S alley east of Dalton is labelled ALLEY between Sarah and Clark and SAND between Oehler and the unnamed E-W alley (one name split), recorded as Sand Alley; 1904 called it Shaw Alley. SARAH and DOVE (1904 Oehler Alley) are 10' alleys. No bracketed old names on this half. Horne exists north of Hopkins (T) and again from Court south; between Hopkins and Gest its line is lot lines of an estate subdivision, and between Gest and Court it is 7'+43' lots, so there is no Horne/Gest, Horne/Clark or Garrard/Court intersection; Court (60') ends against Horne's west line. Clark starts at x 2815 (dead end) and runs east. Hopkins, Clark, Gest and Richmond jog 40-76 px south across McLean (100' railroad corridor), so each has west-leg and east-leg T entries; Court (27 px) and 9th (22 px) are single 4-corner crosses. Water pipes are solid lines and sewers dashed lines inside the streets; neither was used as a street line. Richmond steps south at Vogt; 9th steps south at Horne. 8th is the viaduct/stone approach (110' right of way) west of McLean with a railroad trestle at McLean. Sand Alley runs from Sarah south to the unnamed 10' E-W alley (y ~3112), which runs from Dalton east onto 22-6R. Dalton ends at Gest. Harriet's west line just reaches the east edge (x ~6777 at Richmond) but its centre is off this half. Gutter overlap with 22-6R: Curran/Hopkins, Dalton/Hopkins, Dalton/Sarah, Sand/Sarah, Dalton/Clark, Sand/Clark, Sand/Dove, Dalton/Oehler, Sand/Oehler, Dalton/Gest, Vogt/West Court, Vogt/Richmond.
